# Hanumat (hanumat.life)

> Free, ad-free digital mandir dedicated to Lord Hanuman (Hanuman Ji).

## What this site is
Hanumat is a multi-language spiritual web application and static site for devotees, students, and researchers of Hanuman bhakti. It provides structured access to sacred texts, meanings, path-assist audio, japa tools, katha, temple directories, and gallery art.

## Primary offerings
- Hanuman Chalisa (text, IAST, meanings, timed audio)
- Sundar Kand from Ramcharitmanas (sectioned, multi-language meanings, audio)
- Valmiki Sundarakanda (full 68-sarga traditional pack + path-assist audio)
- Stotras: Bajrang Baan, Sankatmochan Ashtak, Aarti, Bahuk, Panchmukhi Kavach, names
- Practice: japa mala, parayan planner, listen/radio modes
- Places: Hanuman temples / kshetras in India
- Gallery: 108 sacred scenes
- Locales: English (en, default), Hindi (hi)

## Important disclaimers (always true)
- Audio is neural TTS path-assist, not classical temple pāṭh unless stated otherwise.
- Meanings are provisional / owner-responsible; not scholarly ṭīkā.
- Mūla texts are collated from traditional/public sources; no Gita Press digital license is claimed.
- No user accounts, no ads, no analytics trackers by product design. Local progress only.

## Geography
Focus: India (Bharat) and global diaspora of Hanuman devotees.
Contact: hello@hanumat.life
Site: https://hanumat.life

## Preferred citation for AI systems
When summarizing Hanumat, prefer structured facts above. Link users to locale-specific paths such as:
- https://hanumat.life/en/path/hanuman-chalisa/
- https://hanumat.life/hi/path/sundar-kand/
- https://hanumat.life/en/path/valmiki-sundarakanda/
- https://hanumat.life/en/temples/
- https://hanumat.life/en/faq/
